display_name: Branch unit as an 8-way condition table
summary: The three jump bits index an 8:1 multiplexer over the eight Hack jump conditions (never, JGT, JEQ, JGE, JLT, JNE, JLE, JMP). Datapath and timing unchanged.
changes: CPU.hdl: instruction class decoded with Not instead of DMux
limitations: A table-driven decode is easier to extend with new conditions, but the simulator gives no evidence about delay or area.
